groups.name: feature
groups.title: Feature
groups.summary: One module per screen. :feature:<name> always holds a Screen / ViewModel / Route

groups.name: ui
groups.title: UI
groups.summary: :ui and :navigation. Shared UI that belongs to no screen, and the definition of destinations

groups.name: data
groups.title: Data
groups.summary: The :data module. The way into data, and the parts whose implementation differs per platform

groups.name: testing
groups.title: Testing support
groups.summary: Test doubles, the test code itself, the katachi architecture definition, the documents and snapshot written from it, and the ledger of shelved violations

groups.name: app
groups.title: App
groups.summary: The Android app that Gradle builds and the iOS app that Xcode builds

groups.name: Gradle
groups.title: Gradle
groups.summary: The files that make this project a Gradle build

groups.name: GradleWrapper
groups.title: Gradle wrapper
groups.summary: What runs the build with the Gradle version the project pins

groups.name: tool
groups.title: Tool
groups.summary: Files that belong to the tooling around the project, not to the build

roles.name: Screen
roles.title: Screen
roles.summary: The @Composable of one screen. Subscribes to the ViewModel's StateFlow and draws by combining Components

roles.name: ViewModel
roles.title: ViewModel
roles.summary: An androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel that holds screen state. Converts values fetched from the Repository into a UiState and exposes it as a StateFlow

roles.name: Route
roles.title: Route
roles.summary: Ties a screen to a navigation Destination and also takes on creating the ViewModel

roles.name: FeatureComponent
roles.title: Screen component
roles.summary: A @Composable used by only one screen. Placed as <Name>*.kt in the component package of the commonMain of :feature:<name>

roles.name: ScreenPreview
roles.title: Screen preview
roles.summary: A private @Composable annotated with @Preview for a screen. Placed in Home*Preview.kt in the feature module that holds the screen, with the content wrapped in PreviewRoot

roles.name: Component
roles.title: Shared component
roles.summary: The component package of the :ui module. @Composable parts used by several screens

roles.name: Theme
roles.title: Theme
roles.summary: The theme package of the :ui module. The MaterialTheme setup and the design tokens for color and spacing

roles.name: UiCore
roles.title: UI core
roles.summary: The core package of the :ui module. The screen-independent foundation of the UI, such as UiState

roles.name: ComponentPreview
roles.title: Component preview
roles.summary: A private @Composable annotated with @Preview for a component. Placed in <Target>Preview.kt in the component package of :ui, with the content wrapped in PreviewRoot

roles.name: PreviewRoot
roles.title: Preview root
roles.summary: The preview package of the :ui module. Wraps the content of a @Preview in AppTheme and Surface

roles.name: Navigation
roles.title: Navigation
roles.summary: The definition of destinations, and the Navigator that holds the current location

roles.name: RepositoryInterface
roles.title: Repository interface
roles.summary: The :data module's user package. The interface through which the app reads data

roles.name: RepositoryImplementation
roles.title: Repository implementation
roles.summary: The :data module's user package. The implementation of a repository interface

roles.name: ExpectDeclaration
roles.title: Expect declaration
roles.summary: The :data module's platform package. The expect declaration in commonMain that the common side calls

roles.name: ActualImplementation
roles.title: Actual implementation
roles.summary: The :data module's platform package. The actual implementations in androidMain / iosMain

roles.name: Fake
roles.title: Fake
roles.summary: Fake implementations in the commonMain of :testing, used from the tests of other modules

roles.name: Test
roles.title: Test code
roles.summary: The tests of each module. commonTest for KMP modules, src/test for pure Android / pure JVM modules

roles.name: DefinitionEntry
roles.title: Definition entrypoint
roles.summary: ProjectArchitecture.kt, which only calls the group functions and belongs to no layer

roles.name: DefinitionSections
roles.title: Definition sections
roles.summary: DocumentSections.kt, the section headings every group and role writes through

roles.name: GroupDefinition
roles.title: Group definition
roles.summary: groups/<Name>Group.kt, one group of the definition, which lists its roles by calling their functions

roles.name: RoleDefinition
roles.title: Role definition
roles.summary: roles/<Name>Role.kt, one role of the definition, with where its files live

roles.name: ProjectArchitectureTest
roles.title: Architecture test
roles.summary: The single JUnit test that runs the definition, kept in src/test/kotlin of :architecture-test

roles.name: ProjectArchitectureSpec
roles.title: Architecture spec
roles.summary: Tests that verify the definition and katachi itself, kept in src/test/kotlin of :architecture-test

roles.name: CustomProcessor
roles.title: Custom processor
roles.summary: Processors a user adds beside the check katachi ships, kept in the processors package of :architecture-test

roles.name: ProcessorMetadata
roles.title: Processor metadata
roles.summary: Owner.kt, the metadata key and property a custom processor reads, kept in the processors package

roles.name: ProcessorSpec
roles.title: Processor spec
roles.summary: Tests of the custom processors, kept in the processors package of :architecture-test

roles.name: GeneratedDocumentation
roles.title: Generated documentation
roles.summary: Markdown written from this definition and committed to the repository

roles.name: LayoutSnapshot
roles.title: Layout snapshot
roles.summary: A record of this definition, flattened and written out in full. It exists so a person can review changes to the definition as a diff

roles.name: BaselineFile
roles.title: Baseline (ledger of held-back violations)
roles.summary: A ledger that records violations already present when katachi was introduced and holds them back without failing the test

roles.name: ActivityEntrypoint
roles.title: Activity entrypoint
roles.summary: The starting point of the Android app: the ComponentActivity that calls setContent, kept in :app:android

roles.name: AppRoot
roles.title: App root
roles.summary: The whole-app @Composable that MainActivity calls via setContent, kept in :app:android

roles.name: AndroidManifest
roles.title: Android manifest
roles.summary: AndroidManifest.xml of :app:android, which declares the app to Android

roles.name: AndroidResource
roles.title: Android resources
roles.summary: The resource XML under res/ of :app:android. Only :app:android has them

roles.name: XcodeProject
roles.title: Xcode project
roles.summary: Under app/ios. Outside Gradle's management and not checked

roles.name: SettingsScript
roles.summary: Which modules make up the build

roles.name: BuildScript
roles.summary: How one module is built, one per module

constraints.name: namespace of a library module follows the module path

roles.name: GradleProperties
roles.summary: Properties of the build and of the Gradle daemon

roles.name: VersionCatalog
roles.summary: The versions of the build's dependencies and plugins

roles.name: DaemonJvmProperties
roles.summary: Which JVM the Gradle daemon runs on (Gradle 8.8 and later)

roles.name: LauncherScript
roles.summary: The scripts that start the wrapper, for Unix and Windows

roles.name: WrapperJar
roles.summary: The wrapper itself, which downloads and runs Gradle

roles.name: WrapperProperties
roles.summary: Which Gradle distribution the wrapper runs

roles.name: Documentation
roles.title: Documentation
roles.summary: README.md and the like, explanations for people reading the repository

roles.name: Git
roles.summary: .gitignore. Keeps build outputs and Xcode working files out of Git
